title: Single-fold Diophantine representations
summary: Every recursively enumerable set of natural-number tuples has a polynomial Diophantine representation with exactly one complete auxiliary tuple for each member. This proves the single-fold conjecture and, consequently, the finite-fold conjecture.
family_title: Single-fold Diophantine representations and undecidability under an at-most-one-solution promise

review.reason: Proves single-fold Diophantine representations for recursively enumerable sets.
